minor.issue: serper only runs when scrape.do is absent / quota-hit / returned ZERO findings (`not findings`). If scrape.do returns just 1-2 findings the serper top-up never runs, so coverage can silently stay low. Consider `len(findings) < min_total` instead of `not findings`.

Page count is implicit: `range(1, max_pages + 3)` couples serper pages to the scrape.do `max_pages` default (4 -> 6). Add an explicit `serper_pages` parameter so the '5-6 pages' requirement can't drift. Also `num: 100` is sent although the free plan caps at ~10 organic/page (harmless, but misleading).
The combined keyword query includes non-social data-exposure keywords 'pastebin scribd', which dilute the 10 organic slots/page available for the core social platforms on serper's free tier.
Still open from iteration 6: `min(brands, key=...)` raises ValueError if a tenant has neither brand_names nor name.

ui_bugs.issue: Console error on every drawer open: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Wrap the drawer heading in DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden).

action_items: Optional: add DialogTitle to the finding drawer to clear the a11y console error.

Optional hardening: explicit serper_pages param; drop pastebin/scribd keywords from the serper combined query; run serper as a top-up when scrape.do yields few (not only zero) findings; guard empty brands list.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/collectors.py is 1398 lines — split provider adapters (_scrape_do_search/_serper_search/_ddg_search_multi) and the social finding builder into separate modules.
Serper page loop breaks out on ANY non-quota exception (single transient 5xx aborts remaining pages); consider continue-with-retry for one page before aborting.
